headline: Light Matchups
title: Aniimo Light Element Explained | What Light Beats and Fears | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Light has only one weakness, and that is Dark. Light attacks deal one point six times damage to Wind and Dark Aniimo. Light also resists Fire, Water, Grass and Light, so those hits only do zero point six two five times damage. That makes Light a sturdy pick, but keep an answer ready for Dark Aniimo. Do you run Light? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Light element: strong against Wind and Dark, weak only to Dark, and resists Fire, Water, Grass and Light.
